Lower Text: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If your hand has 7 or fewer cards, ＜Draw 1＞.
Upper Text: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Trash the bottom 2 digivolution cards of 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, 1 of their Digimon with 1 or fewer digivolution cards can't attack or block until their turn ends.
